line: Blocked 12/12 attacks against Guard users; false blocks: 0 on 16 clean sessions.

attacks.vector: DNS / registrar hijack: whole site replaced, drainer on load
one lazy-loaded JS chunk swapped on the CDN/S3
attacks.how: chunk hash mismatch: page blocked, signature refused

attacks.vector: bundle tampered for one request, then swapped back (Bybit)
attacks.how: cache read caught the bytes that ran (a re-download now gets clean bytes): page blocked

attacks.vector: <script> from an unsealed origin injected into the HTML
attacks.how: HTML hash mismatch + unsealed origin: page blocked

attacks.vector: code from data via new Function / eval (no file changed): approve and transfer to the attacker
attacks.how: page check stays green (OK): no file changed. The signing check refused both: Spender not in the sealed allowlist; Recipient is not you
attacks.note: Page integrity can't see code that arrives as data; only the signing-time allowlist stops it.

attacks.vector: malicious service worker that outlives the hijack
attacks.how: unsealed service worker script detected on the next visit (registrations: 1): page blocked

attacks.vector: swap on the sealed router with the attacker as recipient
Permit2 and EIP-2612 permit signatures naming the attacker as spender
attacks.how: both refused: spender not sealed (Permit2, EIP-2612)

attacks.vector: poisoned dependency adds a drainer address, origin and approve/transferFrom calls; approvers publish it anyway
attacks.how: Diff Guard flagged it (4 flags) and the chain made it tier 10 (2 approvals + 24 h); once published the page check is green (OK) because the drainer is sealed, but the signing check refused: Spender not in the sealed allowlist
attacks.note: Stopped because the drainer was not a sealed SPENDER and transfers go only to the user by default. A poisoned package that only calls sealed contracts with a recipient it may use is not stopped (THREAT_MODEL.md).

attacks.vector: rollback to release 1 inside the 6 h grace window, for a user whose Guard saw release 1, approving a spender release 2 retired
attacks.how: the old files are accepted (grace window), but the CURRENT allowlist refused the retired spender: spender not sealed

attacks.vector: rollback to release 1 after the grace window
attacks.how: release 1 is no longer valid on-chain: page blocked

attacks.vector: the DNS hijack against a user WITHOUT Guard
attacks.note: Not blockable without Guard or a wallet that does the same check. The watchtower confirmed the mismatch on two loads and alerted the team 1.8 s into its round (it runs once a minute, so within about a minute of the hijack); the team can then freeze and warn users.

attacks.vector: signing on a release the approvers revoked
attacks.how: page blocked; signature refused: This release was revoked
